newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - April 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan unveils the first Saudi produced armoured personnel carrier.
- Lawyers of the British nurses charged with killing their Australian colleague urge the victim's brother to accept their appeal for clemency.
- Agriculture and water minister signs a 838 million riyal water contract with two Italian companies.
- The Saudi Land Transport Company expects 1996 losses to shrink to three million riyals from 15 million riyals in 1995.
- Islamic Development Bank finances 42 educational and industrial projects worth $178 million in Guinea.
